objects.constraint public.audit_events.audit_eve:
CHECK (
CASE action
    WHEN 'booking.bulk_cancellation_admitted'::text THEN
    CASE
        WHEN (jsonb_typeof(details) = 'object'::text) THEN (((details - 'selectedCount'::text) = '{}'::jsonb) AND COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof((details -> 'selectedCount'::text)) = 'number'::text) AND ((details ->> 'selectedCount'::text) ~ '^([1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-5])$'::text)), false))
        ELSE false
    END
    WHEN 'booking.bulk_cancellation_completed'::text THEN
    CASE
        WHEN (jsonb_typeof(details) = 'object'::text) THEN (((details - 'counts'::text) = '{}'::jsonb) AND COALESCE(team_booking_bulk_audit_counts_valid((details -> 'counts'::text)), false))
        ELSE false
    END
    ELSE audit_event_pre_bulk_details_valid(audit_events.*)
END)
objects.constraint public.team_booking_bulk_canc: CHECK ((((claim_token IS NULL) AND (claim_expires_at IS NULL)) OR ((claim_token IS NOT NULL) AND (claim_expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT (outcome IS DISTINCT FROM 'pending'::text)) AND (attempt_count > 0))))
CHECK (((NOT (outcome IS DISTINCT FROM 'pending'::text)) = (next_attempt_at IS NOT NULL)))

CHECK (((outcome IS NULL) OR ((preview_outcome <> 'eligible'::text) AND (outcome = preview_outcome)) OR ((preview_outcome = 'eligible'::text) AND (outcome = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'already_cancelled'::text, 'booking_started'::text, 'booking_not_supported'::text, 'booking_unavailable'::text, 'booking_host_departed'::text, 'authorization_lost'::text, 'processing_failed'::text])))))

CHECK ((
CASE state
    WHEN 'awaiting_confirmation'::text THEN ((admitted_at IS NULL) AND (completed_at IS NULL))
    WHEN 'queued'::text THEN ((admitted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (completed_at IS NULL))
    WHEN 'running'::text THEN ((admitted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (completed_at IS NULL))
    WHEN 'completed'::text THEN ((admitted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (completed_at >= admitted_at))
    ELSE false
END AND ((admitted_at IS NULL) OR ((admitted_at >= created_at) AND (admitted_at < expires_at)))))
objects.constraint public.team_booking_bulk_requ: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES auth.organization(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
objects.index public.team_booking_bulk_cancellat: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX team_booking_bulk_items_active_claim_idx ON public.team_booking_bulk_cancellation_items USING btree (batch_id) WHERE (claim_token IS NOT NULL)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX team_booking_bulk_cancellations_active_team_idx ON public.team_booking_bulk_cancellations USING btree (organization_id) WHERE (state = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'running'::text]))
CREATE INDEX team_booking_bulk_cancellations_admissions_idx ON public.team_booking_bulk_cancellations USING btree (organization_id, admitted_at) WHERE (admitted_at IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX team_booking_bulk_cancellations_completed_retention_idx ON public.team_booking_bulk_cancellations USING btree (completed_at, id) WHERE (state = 'completed'::text)
CREATE INDEX team_booking_bulk_cancellations_preview_expiry_idx ON public.team_booking_bulk_cancellations USING btree (expires_at, id) WHERE (state = 'awaiting_confirmation'::text)
objects.index public.team_booking_bulk_request_l: CREATE INDEX team_booking_bulk_request_limits_actor_idx ON public.team_booking_bulk_request_limits USING btree (organization_id, kind, actor_user_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX team_booking_bulk_request_limits_cleanup_idx ON public.team_booking_bulk_request_limits USING btree (created_at, id)
CREATE INDEX team_booking_bulk_request_limits_team_idx ON public.team_booking_bulk_request_limits USING btree (organization_id, kind, created_at)
